'''Heavy weapons clone troopers''', also called '''heavy gunners''', were one of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] heavy weapon specialist units.

==Characteristics==
[[File:Cannons.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Heavy gunners in the Jedi Temple.]]

These [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] were armed with some of the most powerful explosives and weapons in the [[Army/Legends|army's]] arsenal, including [[Missile/Legends|missiles]], [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]], demolition charges, and other heavy weaponry like cannons. Their main weapons were the largest ever designed to be used by [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] troopers.

They sported some missiles on their belts as well as some targeting range goggles on their forehead and equipped with an communication device including some thick shoulder/sharp knee guards. They had three pouches on the front of their belt. The boots they wore looked more refined and they carried an Unidentified Missile Launcher (as seen in the picture to the right)

==History==
Many heavy [[Gunner/Legends|gunners]] were present at the [[Battle of Utapau/Legends|Battle]] of [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]] when [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] was given. Three such troopers were assigned to eliminate [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], but they were instead [[Death/Legends|killed]] by that [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. Soon thereafter, during the [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|Raid on the Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], heavy gunners were deployed into the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] to bring down the ancient statues and pillars that supported the vaulted ceilings. These clones would later on serve in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and become the heavily armed [[Imperial shock trooper/Legends|Imperial shock troopers]].
